what: Fourteen instruments, each a full-screen animated picture you play. PRESETS changes the instrument, ALGORITHM changes its character, and the four knobs always shape the sound and the picture together. Loop recorder, step sequencer, arpeggiator and metronome built in.
author: Jake Handy
